steps.title: Thaw fecal samples
steps.instruction: Thaw each fecal sample at 20 °C–25 °C (room temperature) for approximately 20 min. Include a negative extraction control (DEPC‑treated, filter‑sterilized water) for each new QIAamp PowerFecal DNA kit and a mock sample in one of the eight extraction batches.

steps.title: Add feces to bead tube
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.1 g (± 0.03 g) of each fecal sample and add it to the Dry Bead Tube supplied with the kit.

steps.title: Add reagents and disrupt cells
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of Bead Solution to the tube and vortex gently. Add 60 µL of dissolved Solution C1, then invert several times or vortex briefly. Heat the tubes at 65 °C for 10 min (optional: prepare the Rotor Adapter during this incubation). Disrupt the samples in a TissueLyser II for 5 min at 30 Hz. Centrifuge the tubes at 13 000 × g for 1 min.

steps.title: Prepare Rotor Adapter and transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Inside a fume hood, set up the QIAcube Rotor Adapter: (a) Position 1 – place a MB Spin Column, lid in position L1; (b) Position 3 – place a 1.5 mL elution tube, lid in position L3. Transfer 450 µL of the cleared supernatant into Rotor Adapter position 2.

steps.title: Run QIAcube DNA purification
steps.instruction: Load the Rotor Adapter, reagent bottle rack, tip racks and accessory buffers according to the QIAcube User Manual (section 5.3). Start the “Purification of DNA from stool and biosolid samples V1” protocol. The automated step takes ~1 h; the whole extraction for 12 samples (including ~1 h automation) requires 2.5–3 h, and processing 96 samples takes ≈3 days (8 runs of 12 samples each). When the screen shows “Protocol complete”, follow the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Store or proceed to DNA quantification
steps.instruction: After extraction, either proceed directly to DNA quantification or store the DNA at 4 °C for short‑term storage or at –20 °C for long‑term storage.

steps.title: Quantify DNA with Qubit assay
steps.instruction: Prepare the Qubit dsDNA HS working solution (Table 1): for 12 samples mix 2 388 µL Qubit dsDNA HS Reagent with 884 µL Qubit dsDNA HS Buffer (total 2 400 µL; per sample 112 µL reagent + 199 µL buffer = 200 µL). For each assay combine 190 µL working solution with either 10 µL Qubit standard (for standards) or 2 µL DNA sample (for unknowns), giving a total volume of 200 µL. Follow the manufacturer’s instructions for the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay (MAN0002326 | MP32851). Pause point: store DNA at 4 °C until all 96 samples are ready for library preparation.

steps.title: Prepare Amplicon PCR master mix
steps.instruction: For each of the 96 wells prepare the following master mix (Table 3, per sample): 5.5 µL 341F primer (1 µM), 5.5 µL 805R primer (1 µM), 12.5 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix 2×. Total master‑mix volume per sample is 25 µL (including the 2.5 µL DNA template). Transfer 22.5 µL of the master mix to each well of a 96‑well plate, then add 2.5 µL of the corresponding DNA sample, mock DNA, or negative control. Pipette up‑and‑down several times, seal the plate and spin for 30 s.

steps.title: Perform Amplicon PCR
steps.instruction: Place the sealed plate in a thermocycler and run the program (Table 4): Initial denaturation 95 °C 3 min; 30 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 55 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C. Timing for the whole library‑preparation (including this PCR) is ≈7–8 h for 96 samples.

steps.title: Clean Amplicon PCR with AMPure beads
steps.instruction: Bring AMPure XP beads to room temperature (20 °C–25 °C). Prepare 80 % ethanol by mixing 40 mL 99.5 % ethanol with 10 mL DEPC‑treated water. Perform the PCR clean‑up exactly as described in the Illumina protocol (pages 8–9).

steps.title: Verify amplicon size (~550 bp)
steps.instruction: Run an aliquot of the cleaned amplicon on a QIAxcel instrument according to the manufacturer’s instructions. The expected amplicon size is ~550 bp.

steps.title: Prepare Index PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Inside a fume hood, prepare the Index PCR master mix (Table 5, per sample): 5 µL Nextera XT Index 1 primer (N7XX, 1 µM), 5 µL Nextera XT Index 2 primer (S5XX, 1 µM), 10 µL KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix 2×, 10 µL PCR‑grade water. Total volume per well is 50 µL (including 5 µL amplicon). Add 5 µL of the cleaned Amplicon PCR product to each well, pipette up‑and‑down, seal and spin for 30 s.

steps.title: Perform Index PCR
steps.instruction: Run the thermocycler with the program (Table 6): Initial denaturation 95 °C 3 min; 8 cycles of 95 °C 30 s, 55 °C 30 s, 72 °C 30 s; final extension 72 °C 5 min; hold at 4 °C.

steps.title: Clean Index PCR
steps.instruction: Perform the Index PCR clean‑up following the Illumina protocol (pages 13–14).

steps.title: Dilute and verify index amplicon (~630 bp)
steps.instruction: In a new 96‑well plate, dilute each Index PCR product 10‑fold by mixing 2 µL of the sample with 18 µL DEPC‑treated, filter‑sterilized water. Verify the size of the diluted amplicons on a QIAxcel; the expected size is ~630 bp.

steps.title: Store plates at -20°C
steps.instruction: Seal the 96‑well plate containing the 10‑fold diluted samples and store at –20 °C for up to one week. Also store the non‑diluted plate at –20 °C for the same period before library normalization.

steps.title: Statistical analysis of sequencing data
steps.instruction: Download the analysis pipeline from https://github.com/magge30/PROPEL-ELBW-16S. For qPCR data, calculate L. reuteri abundance per gram of wet feces using {[10^(mean Cq – y‑intercept) / slope] × dilution factor}/g feces. Perform alpha‑ and beta‑diversity analyses to compare probiotic‑supplemented and placebo groups, following the example code in Martí et al. (2021) and Spreckels et al. (2021).

description: The 16S rRNA gene sequencing protocol described here is optimized for the study of the gut microbiota of extremely low birth weight (ELBW; birth weight < 1,000 g) extremely preterm (born before gestational week 28+0) infants during the neonatal period, using fecal samples as a proxy. However, we have also used the exact same protocol to study the gut microbiota from full-term infants and from the ELBW infants at the age of two. The optimized protocol is based on the following commercial kits, the QIAmp PowerFecal DNA kit (version 12192013) for DNA isolation and the Illumina protocol “16S Metagenomic Sequencing Library Preparation, Preparing 16S Ribosomal RNA Gene Amplicons for the Illumina MiSeq System” Part # 15044223 Rev. B for 16S rRNA gene sequencing. We recommend reading the original protocols before following the optimized protocol below. In this protocol, 96 samples are multiplexed for sequencing. While we do not recommend multiplexing more than 96 samples, it is possible to multiplex less samples. The statistical analyses described here are set to investigate the effect of probiotic supplementation on the gut microbiota. As our study is based on two groups (placebo group vs probiotic-supplemented group), all the analyses are based on a two-group comparison. However, most of the analyses are applicable to a more than two-group comparison. The protocol and timings below are described for 96 samples, including negative controls, which corresponds to the number of samples multiplexed for the 16S rRNA gene sequencing.
